title: Momino Matam Karo Shabbir ka
body:
Momino maatam karo shabbeer ka.
Binte haydar vaarise tat'heer ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Pyaas se jalta tha bach'che ka jigar.
Ayk qatra aab maanga tha magar.
Teer se chheda  gala besheer ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Choor zakhmo'n se badan hai shaah ka
Ro rahi hai peet ke sar faatema.
Zere khanjar hai gala sabbir ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ghutniyo'n bhi chal na paya bezaba'n.
Yaad kar ke ro rahi hai usko ma'n.
ik nisha'n halkoom pe hai teer ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Maarte the kode par kode adoo
Is qadar behta tha aabid ka lahoo.
Surkh loha ho gaya zanjeer ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Yaad kar ke ayk nanha gulbadan.
Haae roti hai rubaabe khastatan.
Dekh kar neze pe sar besheer ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bhai ka laasha hai ran me bekafan.
Haath me zainab ke baandhi hai rasan.
Sar khula balve me hai hamsheer ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Navjava'n pe waar barchhi ka kiya.
Zaalimo'n ne chaak seena kar diya.
Ehmade mukhtaar ki tasveer ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Gham nahi mujko mera ghar lut gaya.
Qabre ehmad par yeh zainab ne kaha.
Hai mujhe gham aal ki tasha'heer ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Kya Waqaar aage likhe  Navshad gham.
Jo huve karbal me sarwar par sitam.
Chaak hota hai jigar tehreer ka.
